status: proposal (claude-a/progression, 25 Oct); every number is a placeholder until play-tests and Claude L's harness
name: Cairn
identity: moss-covered granite golem from the woodland circle, about 90 px; great round fists, a sprout on the LEFT shoulder, two floating pebbles over the RIGHT shoulder
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/cairn.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Bedrock
techniques.effect: Once every few seconds the guard takes a whole hit with no guard cost.

fx: stone flash on the forearms (2 drawings)

upgrade.name: Bedrock II
upgrade.effect: A Bedrock block shoves the attacker back.

techniques.name: Stonebreak
techniques.effect: A boulder that hits a tank cracks its front armour for a few seconds.

upgrade.name: Stonebreak II
upgrade.effect: A boulder that hits any foe slows its next wind-up.

techniques.name: Pebble Ward
techniques.binding: passive: the two pebbles over his right shoulder
techniques.effect: Each pebble catches one projectile and re-forms after a while.

upgrade.name: Pebble Ward II
upgrade.effect: A pebble that catches a shot flicks it back.
